candidate.observed_sign: each candidate is observed multiplied by its own sign s = +1 or -1, drawn from a 4th spawned seed stream; the target uses the unsigned series, so every relationship's sign is unknown in advance

roles.R: c*x_R before the change; zero from the change on (retired driver)
roles.E: zero before the change; from the change on c*f(x_E), f linear or hinge (emerging driver)
roles.D: 0.8*x_E + 0.6*x_indep, no causal effect (correlated proxy of E)

calibration.measure: median over worlds of the pooled skill of ridge{E} vs ridge{} over k = 7..20
calibration.rule: m = 1 if the median is in [0.20, 0.40]; otherwise one step: m = 2 if below, m = 0.5 if above; proceed with the stepped m whatever it measures

record.run: local, before the freeze, 2026-10-02; ridge only

attempts.outcome: stepped m used (the rule takes it whatever it measures)

phase_a.e_sign_rule: E's observed sign is +1 in world i for even i and -1 for odd i, so every set (and the L = 28 subset, worlds 0-7) has as many positive as negative E relationships
phase_a.arms: t0 and ridge, each with no covariate and with {E}; on the linear 7-day set also with {N} (placebo)
phase_a.gate_comparison: C1-C3 must each hold for E against none and for E against N

phase_b.ids: X01..X04, a seeded permutation of R, E, D, N
phase_b.sign: all four observed signs drawn from the seed (no override)
